probe_assessment: The cold read was mostly sound. The probe invented an uppercase YTDLP_THROTTLE_ARGS constant; the module actually exposes the lower-case ytdlp_throttle_args() function at line 223, so that is a probe error rather than a code-induced trap. The probe also overstates check_ytdlp as something that runs before every stage: the function validates PATH when called, but this module does not call it automatically. The listed model-budget stumble is genuine for project-level rationale because 'candidate seats' is undefined, even though the nearby TRIAGE_MODEL and TRIAGE_MAX_TOKENS make the local relationship clear. The TrackNet/streaming stumble is genuine because the module does not identify that consumer or explain how the settings reach it. The D8/D24 stumble is not a finding: lines 104-106 state the flagging rule and the reason instructional rows skip the short-duration flag. Omitted constants are omissions, not material misreadings.
